shorter_stronger_pulse.status: Complete3.6ms without detachment at saved thresholds

driver.method: Exact integrals of piecewise-linear prescribed current; V=IR+L dI/dt. Head modeled as constant cold resistance. Four-quadrant current regulation assumed.
limitations: No PWM ripple, switching/gate losses, current-loop dynamics, bus/lead ringing or protection design.
No capacitor ESR/ripple rating or switch SOA/temperature qualification.
Input R and L assumptions must be replaced with measured assembled values; motional voltage is omitted from this lumped check.
Electrical compliance is not a droplet or repetition-rate prediction.

shorter_stronger_pulse.rationale: Higher initial force and shorter impulse may reduce drop volume. ExactI²dt7.741A²s is15%below200A250us/r.25; this is electrical scaling, not a jet prediction.
limits: Current self-field correction grows with peak current; not fed back.
No assumption that shorter pulses will detach or meet size target.
